ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels exceeding 85% of visible surface area, with low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels localized at the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes; dark-pixel perimeter mapping follows the trailing edge; sparse distribution of sub-centimetric dark circular blobs scattered across the mid-ventral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an obtuse interior angle; depth is minimal relative to the vertical pixel height of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude; sawtooth peaks are most prominent near the mid-lobe sections, becoming highly irregular and high-amplitude at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips; terminal tips exhibit a sharp upward convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distributed low-intensity circular pixel clusters (pitting) across the white surface; high-density dark-pixel rugosity observed at the terminal points of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme dark-pixel texture and irregular geometric erosion at the distal tips, indicating potential heavy scarring or biological colonization.
